tail_selection: stable per-matrix top absolute BF16 value; canonical flat ordinal breaks ties

charged_tail_stream.support: fixed-length combinatorial number system with ceil(log2 C(N,k)) bits
charged_tail_stream.values: minimum exact length among literal BF16, canonical word Huffman, magnitude/sign Huffman, and sign/exponent/mantissa Huffman

residual_geometries: support-pattern-conditioned expert-local Gate/Up/Down XKLT robust bulk
residual_channel: procedural orthogonal RHT followed by an ideal Gaussian polar-lattice test channel
allocation: one panel-wide reverse waterfill closed to exact integer payload bits

matched_controls.construction: normal samples rounded RNE to BF16 symbols and conceptually rescaled to exact per-matrix source energy

early_kill.promotion_rule: only a charged ideal-RD F <= 0.8 warrants a finite CuPy polar-lattice run; a hard kill additionally requires a complete-grid Lagrange-dual lower bound F > 0.8 for every rate and both residual geometries
early_kill.global_certificate: enumerate all 20^3 expert-local tail triples, minimize D+mu(side+payload) independently for all six experts, and maximize the resulting weak-duality lower bound over positive mu
early_kill.stronger_diagnostic: also report a mask-charged envelope with exact tail values and XKLT basis revealed for free

claim_boundary: This protocol gates one exact-lossless-tail architecture. It is not a converse for lossy tail quantization, learned semantic support, or arbitrary nonlinear codecs.
